patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Navigate into the 'Shoot Shoot My Waifu_Data' folder Create two files in this folder, one named 'nude_patch' and one called 'nude_patch.txt' (one file works for some, the other for others, creating both is just easier than trying each) Alternatively, download the patch archive from th It's working if: The waifus can be stripped completely naked, with nothing left covering their sensitive areas.
